title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Engineer
description:
🎨 OpusClip is the world's No.1 AI video agent, built for authenticity on social media.

We envision a world where everyone can authentically share their story through video, with no expertise needed. Within just 18 months of our launch, over 10 million creators and businesses have used OpusClip to enhance their social presence.

We have raised $50 million in total funding and are fortunate to have some of the most supportive investors, including SoftBank Vision Fund, DCM Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, Fellows Fund, AI Grant, Jason Lemkin (SaaStr), Samsung Next, GTMfund, Alumni Ventures, and many more.

Check out our latest coverage by Business Insider featuring our product and funding milestones, and our recognition as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2024.

Headquartered in Mountain View, we are a team of 100 passionate and experienced AI enthusiasts and video experts, driven by our core values:

•
Be a Champion Team

•
Prioritize Ruthlessly

•
Ship fast, Quality Follows

•
Obsess over customers

Be a part of this exciting journey with us!

The Role

OpusClip is building the next generation of AI-native products, and honestly, we need someone who can keep up. We're looking for a Full-Stack AI Engineer who lives at the intersection of applied AI, product instinct, and solid architecture. If you're the type who waits around for a ticket to land in your queue, this isn't it. We need a builder who's genuinely energized by zero-to-one chaos, brings real technical judgment to AI-generated code, and has the grit to ship stuff nobody's seen before.

What We're Looking For

•
You've worked on AI-native codebases before (product or engineering background, doesn't matter) and you know how to bring order to the chaos.

•
Equally comfortable on React up front and Node.js or Django in the back. You don't sit around waiting for someone else to own a layer.

•
You've shipped something from scratch, ideally solo or on a tiny team. You define your own scope and actually like ambiguity.

•
You've got that combat spirit — speed is everything, and shipping feels like a sport to you. (If you've seen the F1 movie, you already get it.)

•
You use Cursor and other AI coding tools fluently, but you also know exactly where their limits are and when it's time for human judgment to take over.

Nice to Haves

•
Multimodal AI engineering (video ML / video AI)

•
A background that blends product thinking with technical depth

Tech Stack

GCP · TypeScript · Python · React · Node.js · Redis · MongoDB · Cloud Storage · LLMs · AI Agents

•

•

•
You can quickly spot visual inconsistencies, quality issues, and creative opportunities that others miss.

•
You understand both the capabilities and limitations of today's AI models and know how to consistently push them further.

•
You naturally think in systems, workflows, and reusable frameworks that help teams scale creative output.

•
You combine artistic judgment with technical curiosity, constantly testing new tools and approaches.

•
You care deeply about the final product and are willing to iterate until the work reaches a high creative standard.

Nice to Have

•
Background in product design, visual design, motion graphics, creative technology, or related fields.

•
Experience building node-based workflows in ComfyUI, Fal, or similar AI infrastructure tools.

•
Previous experience in video production, film, advertising, gaming, or other creative industries.

The Details

•
Location: On-site in Mountain View, CA

•
Competitive salary, equity, and performance-based bonuses

•
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

•
Opportunity to help shape one of the fastest-moving categories in AI

You Should Not Apply If

•
You rarely review or critique your own AI-generated work for quality and consistency.

•

•

•
Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity interfaces, interaction patterns, and detailed implementation specifications.

•
Get hands-on with the front end when it helps, use your working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Git to prototype, ship small fixes, and collaborate tightly with engineers instead of throwing designs over the wall.

•
Set and maintain design consistency, contributing to the systems and guidelines that hold as we scale.

•
Leverage AI tools to accelerate ideation, production, and iteration without compromising quality.

•
A strong track record in product design, with a portfolio of live, shipped work, not just concepts.

A genuine self-starter who thrives with autonomy, examples of projects you scoped, drove, and shipped largely on your own, with minimal direction.

•
Expert-level proficiency in Figma and modern design tooling, with an exceptional sense of layout, typography, interaction, and product thinking.

•
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Git, comfortable prototyping in code, jumping in to fast-fix small front-end issues, and speaking the same language as engineers.

•
Fluency with AI creative and prototyping tools, and a point of view on how to use them (including vibe coding) to work faster and better.

Responsible, organized, and curious. You own your outcomes, keep your work structured, and stay hungry to learn and explore.
